guidance_baseline.surface_control: attachments to rigid or Xformable anchors; no surface vertex kinematic targets
guidance_baseline.surface_rule: triangular UsdGeom.Mesh used as both simulation and collision mesh
guidance_baseline.volume_rule: UsdGeom.TetMesh simulation topology with identical rest topology and exactly one effective collider

limitations: attachment stiffness and damping are not available in current auto attachments
surface-to-surface auto attachments are not supported
surface deformables must use their simulation mesh for collision
static friction is not relied upon; dynamic friction carries contact tuning
surface stretch and shear override stiffnesses are left at zero because the current PhysX implementation does not support them
surface bending uses thickness-aware bend stiffness
rest topology is not mutated during simulation; cuts and repair continuity are represented by explicit topology ledgers and removable attachments
